bootstrap.scope: Descriptive resampling of selected leakage groups, not corpus-wide confidence.

local_retrieval.scope: Recall of reviewed positive IDs; no generation or exhaustive precision/F1

exploratory_retrieval.scope: Post-run local exploration; not used to choose or retune the frozen live baseline. No generation or accuracy claim for unknown labels.

frameworks.limits: Contract pass is not semantic accuracy. Candidate-ID recall is not passage recall. Three grounding cases do not calibrate a judge.

live_workspace_observation.scope: Evaluation opens app SQLite read-only. A later live GitHub sync can change its workspace; that observation is retained and is not rolled back. Ground Truth/sample states and all reference records are checked separately.

preservation.ledger_boundary: The monetary SQLite database changed intentionally for the approved 50 evaluations. The 91 historical call rows and their total charges are separately recounted; unchanged database bytes are not claimed.

limits: Selected single-reviewer partial-positive references. Unknown predictions are not false positives; exhaustive precision/F1 remain unavailable. No owner identity, individual review, raw prediction, full source or credential is exported here.
